items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Oh, one of them was the drummer, was named Baby Lewis.

ctx.x: He played saxophone. And the other -- I don't remember the other names. Oh, one of them was the drummer, was named Baby Lewis. I think he's down in Texas somewhere. And I don't remember too many of the other names.
I think you mentioned that it was somewhere around then that you joined the Musician's Union, wasn't it?
